channel.title: Pier & Point · PG&E Southern Switchyard
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for PG&E Southern Switchyard (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · PG&E Southern Switchyard: The name carried a note, "outside the project boundary
item.description: The name carried a note, "outside the project boundary; not part of redevelopment", which is a statement about the site rather than a name. The statement stays in the record's text. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: No source change; the record's own text already gives the boundary statement and its source..

item.title: Correction · PG&E Southern Switchyard: The PG&E switchyard page no longer says no parcel was found
item.description: The PG&E switchyard page no longer says no parcel was found. DataSF lists an active lot at 1101 Illinois Street, recorded October 15, 2024, under about 78 percent of this drawing; it is larger than the drawing and it is not stated who owns it or whether it is a switchyard parcel. The older lot named in the 2018 environmental report (4175018) was retired the same day. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=4175499 ; https://sfmea.sfplanning.org/2017-011878ENV_DEIR_Volume_1.pdf ; https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station.

item.title: Correction · PG&E Southern Switchyard: The Design for Development shows two PG&E switchyards: a…
item.description: The Design for Development shows two PG&E switchyards: a 4.8-acre Northern Switchyard at 22nd and Illinois inside the project boundary (covered on this map by Blocks 13 and 14), and a Southern Switchyard outside it. The shape on this record is the Southern one, so the record now says so: the 4.8-acre area and the 22nd and Illinois location were moved to the Northern Switchyard, the claim that it is outside the redevelopment site is limited to the Southern one, and the earlier comparison of the shape's area to 4.8 acres was withdrawn as coincidental. The shape itself was not changed. The dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document, the label location was corrected to east of Illinois Street, and the land-use figure is tagged as a document rather than a rendering. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station project page (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station).
